> Make the OP team and duel.

### **What Plasmo.top is..**

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/pqNDdH9G-UU" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Players can "/team create" a team and they can "/team invite *player*" and the more players ## there are the more levels the team gets 

levels can be turns into effects, enchants or items.

**1: Nothing [Default Level]**

**2: +2 Health [More Health Level]**

**3: +1 Strength [Strength Level]**

**4: Chainmail Armor (everytime they die they get it back unless they leave the team or level up to Iron Armor Protection I) [Armour Level]**

**5: +2 Strength instead of +1 [Strongest Level]**

**6: +4 health instead of +2 [Healthy Level]**

**7: They can go invisible at anytime by pressing b (particles shown for only 10 seconds and a cooldown of 20 seconds) [Unseen Level]**

**8. Chainmail Armor Protection I (everytime they die they get it back unless they leave the team) [Protected Level]**

**9. +2 haste and +2 speed [Speedy Level]**

**10. They can go invisible at anytime by pressing b (particles shown for 15 seconds and a cooldown of 15 seconds) [Invisible Level]**

# you can duel with "/teamduel *teamname*!"

🥇What happens to the team that loses - they all get kicked but and all of the team cant "/team invite" each other for 5 days (could make the day customizable in the files like a yml file thingy.)

🥉What happens to the team that wins  - a random player the team get loot:

netherite scrap, netherite ingot, sharp 1-4 book, looting 1-3, 64 windcharges and protection 1-4 random armour piece.
